notes.title: An Official Announcement & A Special Offer: From Haunted Space to HELL GALAXY
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p align="start"]Today, September 4th, we are posting an official announcement to reach EVERYONE who has supported this project, including those who might have missed our previous post in the discussion forums. We want to provide final clarity on the future of the game you've wishlisted.[/p][p align="start"]Your patience deserves the utmost transparency. The single-player experience you were waiting for—a dark, narrative-driven journey through deep space—has not been cancelled. Instead, it has evolved and grown into its own standalone project, with a new and stronger identity: [b]HELL GALAXY[/b].[/p][p align="start"][b]What does this mean for you?[/b][/p][p align="start"]The game you wanted exists, and it's already available in Early Access. To continue following its development, receive all future updates, and support the project, you need to move your interest to its new official page.[/p][p align="start"][b]How to find HELL GALAXY (Official Instructions):[/b] Due to new Steam regulations, we cannot post a direct link here. The correct way to find it is:[/p][olist][*][p][b]Click on our studio's name, "Italian Games Factory", on this page.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]You will be taken to our official Creator Page, where you will find [b]HELL GALAXY[/b] featured prominently.[/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][p align="start"][b]A special opportunity for you[/b][/p][p align="start"]By a happy coincidence, right now and [b]throughout the weekend[/b], HELL GALAXY is available with a [b]20% discount[/b].[/p][p align="start"]Please consider this a thank you for your long wait and the perfect chance to jump right into the action. It's our welcome offer to you for this new chapter.[/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"]For any possible questions, we have already prepared a [b]comprehensive FAQ[/b] that you can find as a pinned post in our discussion hub.[/p][p align="start"]Thank you for your understanding and your support during this transition. We look forward to seeing you in HELL GALAXY![/p][p align="start"][i]The Italian Games Factory Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: FAQ — From Haunted Space to HELL GALAXY
notes.content: [p][b]Q: So the game I had on my wishlist no longer exists?[/b][/p][p align="start"][b]A:[/b] On the contrary! The original concept — a [b]single-player[/b] space adventure (story-driven) — has been built and expanded. It’s now called [b]HELL GALAXY[/b] and is already available in [b]Early Access[/b] on its official page. We separated the projects to give each game proper care and to give this experience an identity and a name aligned with its scope in the universe ([i]single-player game[/i] and [i]franchise[/i]).[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Q: Why the name change?[/b][/p][p align="start"][b]A:[/b] We understand it can be confusing. Over a [b]years-long[/b] development, the project gained such a strong identity that it deserved its own name: [b]HELL GALAXY[/b], reflecting its spirit and ambition. This separation helps us clearly communicate the nature of this specific experience.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Q: What should I do to keep up with updates and news for the single-player?[/b][/p][p align="start"][b]A:[/b] The most important step is to [b]add HELL GALAXY to your wishlist[/b].[/p][p align="start"]Recommended path ([b]no direct links[/b]):[/p][p align="start"][/p][olist][*][p]At the top, click [b]Italian Games Factory[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]On the [b]Author Page[/b], open the list [b]“Play Now: Hell Galaxy (Single-Player).”[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Go to the [b]HELL GALAXY[/b] page and [b]add it to your wishlist[/b]. [i](You can also [b]Follow[/b] the Author Page to receive notifications.)[/i][/p][p]Alternatively, if you see the [b]“Hell Galaxy Universe”[/b] breadcrumb, open the [b]/franchise/[/b] hub and you’ll find [b]HELL GALAXY[/b] there.[/p][/*][/olist][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p][quote][p]If you prefer to keep your list tidy, you [b]can[/b] remove Haunted Space — it’s optional.[/p][/quote][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Q: What will happen to this Haunted Space page?[/b][/p][p align="start"][b]A:[/b] It remains the official channel for the [b]legacy project[/b]. At this stage, we’re focusing our energy and communications on [b]HELL GALAXY[/b]’s single-player to deliver the best possible experience.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Q: Do saves or purchases transfer?[/b][/p][p align="start"][b]A:[/b] [b]No.[/b] They’re distinct projects: saves and entitlements do not transfer.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Q: Where can I find the full roadmap, patch notes, and devlogs?[/b][/p][p align="start"][b]A:[/b] On the [b]HELL GALAXY[/b] page. Here on the legacy page we’ll post [b]periodic summaries[/b] and [b]reminders[/b].[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Q: Are discounts planned?[/b][/p][p align="start"][b]A:[/b] Yes—[b]periodic discount windows[/b] for [b]HELL GALAXY[/b]. To avoid missing them, [b]Follow[/b] the [b]Author Page[/b] and [b]add the game to your wishlist[/b].[/p]

notes.title: An Important Announcement: single-player continues in HELL GALAXY
notes.content:
[p]Hi Raiders,[/p][p align="start"]we’re sharing a key update about the project you wishlisted.[/p][p align="start"]Thank you for your support and patience—our galactic journey is finally taking shape.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]The [b]single-player[/b] experience you were waiting for not only exists: it has grown, evolved, and is now available in [b]Early Access[/b] under a new name: [b]HELL GALAXY[/b].[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]To keep following development and receive notifications about updates and offers, please shift your attention to the [b]new official page[/b].[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]How to proceed:[/b][/p][p align="start"][/p][olist][*][p]At the top, [b]click our studio name “Italian Games Factory.”[/b][/p][/*][*][p]On the [b]Author Page[/b], open the list [b]“Play Now: Hell Galaxy (Single-Player).”[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Open the [b]HELL GALAXY[/b] page and add it to your [b]wishlist[/b]. [i](You can also [b]Follow[/b] the Author Page to get notifications.)[/i][/p][/*][/olist][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p][quote][p]Alternatively, if you see the [b]“Hell Galaxy Universe”[/b] breadcrumb, open the [b]/franchise/[/b] hub and you’ll find HELL GALAXY there.[/p][/quote][p align="start"][/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p][h2][b]What changes / what doesn’t[/b][/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p][list][*][p]✅ [b]Single-player[/b]: continues on [b]HELL GALAXY[/b] (full roadmap, patch notes, and devlogs will be posted there).[/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Legacy[/b]: this page remains the official channel for legacy updates and notes.[/p][/*][*][p]❌ [b]Data transfers[/b]: saves/entitlements do not carry over (distinct projects).[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p][h2][b]Roadmap & updates[/b][/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]We’ll publish the [b]roadmap[/b], [b]patch notes[/b], and [b]devlogs[/b] on the [b]HELL GALAXY[/b] page. Here you’ll find periodic summaries and reminders.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p][h2][b]Pricing & discounts[/b][/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]We’ll run [b]periodic discounts[/b] for HELL GALAXY. To avoid missing them, [b]Follow[/b] the [b]Author Page[/b] and [b]wishlist[/b] the game.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p][h2][b]Feedback & support[/b][/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Use [b]Steam Discussions[/b] and share constructive feedback; it helps us prioritize improvements and QoL.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]This is the best way to make sure you don’t miss anything from the game we’ve looked forward to together.[/p][p align="start"]Thank you for your understanding and trust—we can’t wait to show you the galaxy that [b]HELL GALAXY[/b] has in store, the result of years of hard work.
Thank you for supporting our universe—from [b]Haunted Space[/b] to [b]HELL GALAXY[/b].[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Italian Games Factory Team[/b][/p]
